name: Equinox Hotel, Hudson Yard
insider_take: This isn't just a hotel—it's a wellness sanctuary floating 500 feet above Manhattan's newest neighborhood, where every detail is designed to optimize your mind, body, and spirit.
whats_special: The Equinox Hotel occupies floors 14-28 of the gleaming Hudson Yards tower, featuring the largest hotel gym in NYC with a 60,000-square-foot fitness facility. Each room comes with in-room fitness equipment, circadian lighting that adjusts throughout the day, and purified air systems. The hotel sits atop the High Line's northern terminus and offers direct access to the Edge observation deck—the Western Hemisphere's highest outdoor sky deck.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 25+ for unobstructed views of the Hudson River and Central Park. The hotel's RoomFit program delivers Technogym equipment directly to your suite within 15 minutes of request.
dont_miss: The 25th-floor spa with its hammam-inspired relaxation lounge and the Electric Lemon restaurant's weekend brunch with panoramic city views. Take the elevator to the Vessel sculpture just steps away, or catch a Broadway show—the Theater District is a quick 10-minute walk through the climate-controlled pedway system.
pros: State-of-the-art fitness facilities and wellness amenities
Modern luxury accommodations in prime Hudson Yards location
Integrated fitness and wellness lifestyle experience
Contemporary design with premium amenities and services
cons: Fitness-focused atmosphere may not appeal to all travelers
